cleanup_scope: Replace obsolete Ocean/starred blocks and duplicate application helpers; consolidate Ocean execution in helpers.R and reporting/diagnostics in plotting.R, following the upstream three-module structure. Retain all non-Ocean implementations.
resource_budget: cores shared across fits/chains fixed by profile; analysis single worker
identity_recovery: Initial fit preserves incompatible old output and selects a new timestamped directory, printing the actual path. Default later actions follow the latest run marker.
calibration: Class-stratified nested approximate Latin coverage of salinity/log pressure; recorded C/X only
